sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout searched llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety candidates and recommended current-week papers including OpenForgeRL, AREX, Dark Room, and QuantiBias.
The selected arXiv paper was read from abstract, HTML, PDF extraction, Zenodo metadata, and external paper-index references.
The article extracts the GRPO advantage formula, prediction-sufficiency signal, ALFWorld and HiddenRule-Gym setup, ablations, channel matrix, and reproducibility limits.
The writeup separates demonstrated claims from single-seed, group-size, validation-noise, 8B-baseline, and missing-code limitations.
